issues.quote: At nine Monnier had made us all show our watches, as he does every year.
issues.fact: B1 says only that at dinner Girard would not show the master his watch. No clock time for the watch-showing is given, and nothing places it at nine.
issues.misreading: A solver could take 9 o'clock as a fixed time anchor for the watch inspection and infer when dinner ended or when Girard was in the dining room, a timing reading the sheet does not give.

issues.quote: I did not play cards with him tonight and I was glad of it.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about cards or about any dealings with Dr Vauthier. It only places Girard in the dining room after dinner and in the street from 10:21.
issues.misreading: The denial adds a whereabouts or activity claim the sheet does not give, which a solver could treat as a clue about where Girard or others were during the evening.
